# Data Preparation

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(haven)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)

efcu <- read_sav("../Case 31 Data_efcu_4.sav")
names(efcu) <- tolower(names(efcu))

dim(efcu)
```

## Variable Selection

```{r}
h5_items <- efcu |>
  select(q31, q32, q33, q34, q37)

summary(h5_items)

attr(efcu$q37, "labels")
```

## Recoding

```{r}
efcu$q37_r <- ifelse(
  efcu$q37 %in% 1:5,
  6 - as.numeric(efcu$q37),
  NA_real_
)

summary(efcu$q37_r)
```

# Multiple Regression Analysis

## Descriptive Statistics

```{r}
h5_data <- efcu |>
  select(q31, q32, q33, q34, q37_r) |>
  filter(complete.cases(q31, q32, q33, q34, q37_r))

h5_descriptive <- data.frame(
  Variable = names(h5_data),
  N = nrow(h5_data),
  Mean = sapply(h5_data, mean),
  SD = sapply(h5_data, sd)
)

knitr::kable(
  h5_descriptive,
  digits = 3,
  row.names = FALSE,
  caption = "Descriptive Statistics for H5a-H5d"
)
```

## Regression Model

```{r}
h5_model <- lm(
  q37_r ~ q31 + q32 + q33 + q34,
  data = h5_data
)

summary(h5_model)
```

## Interpretation

The regression model was statistically significant,
F(4, 116) = 12.46, p < .001, with R² = .301.

- H5a: Confidentiality was a significant positive predictor (B = .188, p = .036).
- H5b: Loan processing promptness was a significant positive predictor (B = .308, p < .001).
- H5c: Adequacy of financial services was a significant positive predictor (B = .294, p < .001).
- H5d: Loan application simplicity was not significant (B = -.068, p = .390).

H5a, H5b, and H5c were supported, while H5d was not supported.

## Regression Diagnostics

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(h5_model)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```
